description: An intent edit on a seeded form becomes the question "Apply these changes from your edit?" (tests/e2e/intent-edit-question.spec.ts). The one model call (refineSchemaFromIntent) is HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded: the test checks the flow (question, preview, scoped apply), not the model.
steps: Edit the purpose of a form that has fields and choose Refine Form (refineSchemaFromIntent, hand-written)
The change is offered as a question; the form is unchanged
Choose "Apply the changes" from its preview
